_note: Preset scenarios: the five worked examples of spec 7A.12 (FR-22b, AC-6). Platform values override the defaults in platformDefaults.json. The Example 1 Wi-Fi video bitrate (150 Mbps) is chosen so the stream is near continuous, which the example needs.

presets.name: Example 1: A2DP and Wi-Fi 7 on a shared antenna
presets.summary: A2DP at 328 kbps shares one antenna with a Wi-Fi 7 video stream. Wi-Fi wins until A2DP has four packets waiting, then A2DP becomes critical.
presets.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

presets.name: Example 2: separate antennas and 40 dB isolation
presets.summary: The same traffic, but with separate antennas and high isolation. The overlaps still happen, and they are tolerated.
presets.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

presets.name: Example 3: Wi-Fi channel overlap hurts Bluetooth hops
presets.summary: Separate antennas with only 10 dB isolation and no adaptive hopping. Bluetooth hops that land inside the Wi-Fi channel are degraded.
presets.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

presets.name: Example 4: adaptive hopping fixes it
presets.summary: The same setup with adaptive frequency hopping on. After the map takes effect, Bluetooth stays out of the Wi-Fi channel.
presets.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

presets.name: Example 5: time sharing adds latency to a BLE link
presets.summary: A BLE connection and Wi-Fi 6 web browsing share one antenna with a 50/50 time share in 5 ms slices. Connection events that fall in a Wi-Fi slice are denied and retried at the next event.
presets.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES
